reason: In DefaultTokenContextEncoderProviderFactory.postInit (patch lines 432-441), the value from gtf.getShortcut() goes straight into ConcurrentHashMap.put as both key and value with no null check, so a factory returning null throws an NPE when the server starts. No factory in this repo returns null (all nine return non-null literals), so only a custom OAuth2GrantTypeFactory that breaks the new getShortcut() contract would hit it.
